text: This code is a correct implementation of the Fibonacci sequence using recursion. It takes an integer n as input and returns the n-th Fibonacci number. The base cases are handled correctly, with fibonacci(0) and fibonacci(1) returning 0 and 1, respectively. For n >= 2, the function calls itself recursively with the arguments n-1 and n-2, effectively calculating the nth Fibonacci number as the sum of the two preceding ones. This approach is a straightforward and efficient way to compute Fibonacci numbers, and the code accurately reflects the mathematical definition of the sequence.
